interpretations: For each patient-sex group with more laboratory records than the average across all sex groups, report the sex, record count, count divided by the total record count across **all** sex groups, and count minus the average; leave values unrounded.

For each patient-sex group with more laboratory records than the average across all sex groups, report the sex, record count, count divided by the total record count across **qualifying** sex groups, and count minus the average; leave values unrounded.
queries:
WITH sex_counts AS (
    SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(l.ID) AS record_count
    FROM Patient AS p
    LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY p.SEX
),
totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count,
           AVG(record_count) AS average_count
    FROM sex_counts
)
SELECT s.SEX,
       s.record_count,
       1.0 * s.record_count / t.total_count,
       s.record_count - t.average_count
FROM sex_counts AS s
CROSS JOIN totals AS t
WHERE s.record_count > t.average_count

WITH sex_counts AS (
    SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY p.SEX
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT SEX, record_count,
           record_count - (SELECT AVG(record_count) FROM sex_counts) AS count_minus_average
    FROM sex_counts
    WHERE record_count > (SELECT AVG(record_count) FROM sex_counts)
)
SELECT SEX,
       record_count,
       1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS proportion,
       count_minus_average
FROM qualifying
